statements.english: Oh ! Okay , that actually makes more sense . So how was it ?
statements.chinese: 哦！好吧，这样确实更合理。那么情况如何？

statements.english: It was , it was really nice . We started talking and II ended up having lunch with him
statements.chinese: 那真是，真的很愉快。我们开始交谈，最后我还和他一起吃了午餐。

statements.english: That is so weird ! I had a dream that you'd have lunch with Richard
statements.chinese: 这太奇怪了！我梦见你会和Richard共进午餐。

statements.english: Really ?
statements.chinese: 真的吗？

statements.english: But again , Richard Simmons . Go on
statements.chinese: 但又来了，Richard Simmons。继续吧。

Go.definition: 短语动词原型: 继续

statements.english: The strange part was , he was really nice
statements.chinese: 奇怪的是，他人真的很好,

statements.english: umm and he looks great , but I didn't feel anything at all !
statements.chinese: 呃，他看起来很棒，但我一点感觉都没有！

looks.definition: look（第三人称单数）: 看起来

statements.english: Ooh ! So now why can't we tell Chandler ?
statements.chinese: 噢！那我们现在为什么不能告诉Chandler呢？

statements.english: Because it would totally freak him out
statements.chinese: 因为这绝对会让他抓狂

statements.english: and tomorrow's our anniversary
statements.chinese: 明天是我们的纪念日。

statements.english: I just don't want anything to spoil that
statements.chinese: 我只是不想让任何事情破坏这一切。

statements.english: Oh , I can't believe you guys lasted a whole year !
statements.chinese: 天啊，真不敢相信你们居然坚持了整整一年！

statements.english: I know
statements.chinese: 我知道。

statements.english: Wow ! I owe Rachel 20 bucks !
statements.chinese: 哇！我欠Rachel 20块钱！

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: On a totally different bet
statements.chinese: 完全是另一回事。

statements.english: It's almost our anniversary !
statements.chinese: 快到我们的纪念日了！

statements.english: I know . Can you believe it ?
statements.chinese: 我知道。你能相信吗？

statements.english: One year ago today I was just your annoying friend Chandler
statements.chinese: 一年前的今天，我还只是你那个烦人的朋友Chandler。

statements.english: Awww ! Now you're just my annoying friend Chandler
statements.chinese: 哎呀！现在你只是我那烦人的朋友Chandler了。

statements.english: I got you a present !
statements.chinese: 我给你准备了礼物！

statements.english: Oh , but it's not ' til tomorrow !
statements.chinese: 哦，但那要到明天呢！

statements.english: I know , but you have to open it today !
statements.chinese: 我知道，但你必须今天打开它！

statements.english: Okay
statements.chinese: 好的。

statements.english: Okay ! There you go !
statements.chinese: 好了！给你！

statements.english: It's two tickets to Vegas !
statements.chinese: 这是两张去拉斯维加斯的票！

statements.english: For this weekend !
statements.chinese: 本周末！

statements.english: Oh gosh , it would be perfect , we get to see Joey
statements.chinese: 天哪，这简直太完美了，我们能见到Joey了

statements.english: plus we get to start our anniversary celebration on the plane
statements.chinese: 而且我们还能在飞机上就开始我们的周年庆祝。

statements.english: We can call it out plane-aversary
statements.chinese: 我们可以称之为飞机纪念日。

call.definition: 短语动词原型: 称呼

statements.english: Do we have to ?
statements.chinese: 我们非得这样吗？

statements.english: No
statements.chinese: 编号。

statements.english: Okay this is great , but Joey said he didn't want any of us out there
statements.chinese: 这确实很棒，但Joey说过他不想让我们任何人出现在那里。

statements.english: Oh , he just doesn't want us to go through any trouble
statements.chinese: 哦，他只是不想让我们费心。

statements.english: Think of how excited he'll be when we go out and surprise him !
statements.chinese: 想想我们出去给他个惊喜时，他会有多兴奋！

statements.english: Plus we get to have our own , ani-Vegas-ary !
statements.chinese: 而且我们还能庆祝自己的反拉斯维加斯纪念日！

statements.english: A-Nevadaversary !
statements.chinese: 内华达周年庆！

statements.english: Yeah , I think we should see other people
statements.chinese: 嗯，我觉得我们应该各自考虑其他人了。

statements.english: But we can go , right ?
statements.chinese: 但我们能去，对吧？

statements.english: - Yes . - Okay !
statements.chinese: 好的。 - 明白！

statements.english: It's a great idea
statements.chinese: 这是个好主意。

statements.english: Okay , I'm gonna go too !
statements.chinese: 好的，我也要走了！

statements.english: Y'know Pheebs , it's kinda our anniversary
statements.chinese: 知道吗Pheebs，今天算是我们的纪念日。

statements.english: Oh please , you are not gonna ditch again like you did with London
statements.chinese: 拜托，你不会又要像在London那次一样放鸽子吧。

statements.english: Ditch you ? Phoebe , you were pregnant with the triplets !
statements.chinese: 抛弃你？Phoebe，你当时怀着三胞胎呢！

were.definition: were（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: Uh-huh , great story ! I'm going !
statements.chinese: 嗯哼，好精彩的故事！我走啦！

statements.english: Hey , you guys , listen
statements.chinese: 嘿，你们几个，听着，

statements.english: this weekend we're all gonna go to Las Vegas to surprise Joey !
statements.chinese: 这周末我们都要去Las Vegas给Joey一个惊喜！

statements.english: Including me !! You wanna go ?!
statements.chinese: 包括我！！你想去吗？！

statements.english: Well , I guess I could take a couple days off work
statements.chinese: 嗯，我想我可以请几天假。

statements.english: Of course you can take a couple days off work
statements.chinese: 当然你可以请几天假

statements.english: because this trip includes me !
statements.chinese: 因为这次旅行包括我！

includes.definition: include（第三人称单数）: 包括
